diagnosis: Four B outputs consume the limit while emitting records. ALT/MILLIE additionally show long whitespace immediately after the first VALUE evidence array. Existing nested anyOf is officially supported, so these observations do not prove a logically impossible schema.
mechanism: Kind-specific arrays remove union branches and record wrappers; shorter keys and actual-read-coordinate expansion remove redundant output. Nullable value bookkeeping precedes evidence.
limits: No model API request by this agent. Live whitespace and completion effects remain unverified.
Complete saved record prefixes are used only to measure serialization size; no truncated extraction is accepted, repaired, or used as a new answer.
Observed prefix savings are 10.1%-23.2% with both forms minified; this does not establish a complete six-case extraction will fit the old 5000-token budget.
Record list interleaving changes to fixed kind groups; all payloads, IDs, within-kind order, notes and the registered immutable snapshot identity are preserved.
Adapter does not establish economic truth. Existing gateway/registration still performs semantic validation.
official_reference_observation: Structured Outputs supports nested anyOf; root must be an object, every field required, additionalProperties false. Incomplete responses still require application handling.
